title: App good, support terrible
body: I like the app functions and design - it offers exactly what I need. However, almost every update messes with my habit settings somehow (e.g. old and new habits are not showing up in daily schedule, habits stats for previous achievements are reset etc). Support team only answer emails when they want. Once, after installing another update, the app simply wouldn’t launch. I have notified the support team and got a response that they’re aware of the issue and working on it. After 5 days the problem finally got fixed and I asked whether I’ll get a refund for these 5 days because I’m paying yearly subscription - no response. Also support team keeps addressing you in emails with your last name (e.g. “Hello Smith”), although everytime I write an email I use my first name in the signature (e.g. “Thanks, John”). When I pointed that out, again, no response. I’m now waiting for another update so that the app can work properly again. My conclusion - keep developing the app, fire testers and support team.
